value.action: Ignore local secret/config files where appropriate
effects: untracked matching files are excluded

value.action: Use secret scanning and pre-commit checks
effects: credentials can be detected before publication

value.action: If a secret was committed, revoke or rotate it immediately
effects: exposed credential is no longer trusted

value.action: Coordinate history cleanup and remote cleanup
effects: sensitive content may be removed by history rewrite, but clones/caches may retain copies

value.action: Use revert rather than rewriting ordinary shared history
effects: published shared history remains stable for routine changes
